ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a side anatomical/part schematic diagram of a horse, with multiple arrows pointing to different parts of the horse's body and limbs. At the end of the horse's lower limb, the hoof touching the ground can be seen, above the hoof there is a shorter leg connecting segment, and further above is the joint area. Reasoning: The question asks about the part on a horse's foot located between the fetlock and the hoof. According to horse anatomical terminology, the short segment between the fetlock and the hoof is called the pastern.
